text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your knee condition, how long have you been experiencing this swelling, and does the pain worsen with activity or rest?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sickle Cell Trait (Unlikely given age and presentation; consider Hemophilia or Factor VIII deficiency). Based on the family history of similar unexplained joint swelling in a male child with no trauma, I suspect a bleeding disorder like Hemophilia A or B. Can you confirm if there is a history of excessive bleeding after cuts or bruising elsewhere in the family? REQUEST TEST: Coagulation Profile (PT, PTT, INR).
